d: Short-cut jet black hair with a side-swept fringe and a smooth texture frames a mature, young adult face with sharp, narrow purple eyes. The slender build is dressed in a traditional layered kimono ensemble featuring a deep navy blue outer robe with a subtle geometric pattern and a purple under-robe with light purple curved accents. The outfit is secured by a gold-accented black obi belt, paired with black lace-up heeled boots. The character carries a massive, futuristic white and black mechanical weapon with glowing pink accents.
